versions.changelog: Fixed the script crash on success and on errors (emit/fail were missing since the keyless first-look change)

- Initial release of douyin-video-to-text.
- Extracts transcript (with timestamps), on-screen text and subtitles, title, description, chapters, key points, and video stats from Douyin videos.
- Works with douyin.com and v.douyin.com links or share codes.
- Free daily summary without API key; full transcript with registered API key (10 free credits on signup).
- No need to download videos or login to Douyin; does not require cookies.
- Detailed usage instructions, API, and script examples included.
